subject: Error in counting events and questions about +w and validation

messages.author: e1fb63cf7b85186e
messages.subject: Error in counting events and questions about +w and validation
parts:
Hi, Nick!

I am new in R and Biogeobears. I have some question about the time stratified +j+w models, and I encountered error while running my data. Could you please help me with them?

1) Max of "w" is set to 3 in one post in this group. Is it mandatory or suggested to be less than 3? If I use default max of w, and it is estimated larger than 3, say, 7, how should we deal with it? Should we adjust the dispersal multipliers in subsequent analysis since the estimated w value suggested that differences between multipliers should be increased?  

2) When we do validation of BSM for model, should we use the "all_1s" dispersal multipliers file or the one we used in model comparison?

3) I encountered error while running count_clado_events_nonjumo() in the "#Count all anagenetic and cladogenetic events" step. Please find below the error massage. I used the simulate_source_areas_ana_clado() to add column in ana_events_tables, but I don't know have I done it right and how to add column in clado_events_tables. Any help will be very appreciated!

Thank you very much and wish you a happy new year!

Ariel


###########################################################################################################
> counts_list = count_clado_events_nonjump(clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames, actual_names)

count_ana_clado_events() is counting events over Biogeographical Stochastic Map (BSM) #:
1 

STOP ERROR in count_clado_dispersal_events(): input 'clado_events_table' must have a column 'clado_dispersal_from'. To add this column, run simulate_source_area_clado() or simulate_source_areas_ana_clado().

Error in count_clado_dispersal_events(clado_events_table, areanames = areanames,  : 
  STOP ERROR in count_clado_dispersal_events(): input 'clado_events_table' must have a column 'clado_dispersal_from'. To add this column, run simulate_source_area_clado() or simulate_source_areas_ana_clado().
Called from: count_clado_dispersal_events(clado_events_table, areanames = areanames, 
    actual_names = actual_names)
############################################################################################################

messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Re: Error in counting events and questions about +w and validation
parts:
Hi -- if you run the example BSM script straight through, without accidentally skipping any steps, this error should not appear.  You can see how it should go in the example script right here:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeographical-stochastic-mapping-example-script
===============
# Simulate the source areas
BSMs_w_sourceAreas = simulate_source_areas_ana_clado(res, clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames)
clado_events_tables = BSMs_w_sourceAreas$clado_events_tables
ana_events_tables = BSMs_w_sourceAreas$ana_events_tables

# Count all anagenetic and cladogenetic events
counts_list = count_ana_clado_events(clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames, actual_names)
===============


Cheers!
Nick

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Re: Error in counting events and questions about +w and validation
parts:
On Fri, Nov 24, 2017 at 9:55 PM, Justine Vandendorpe <justine.i.c....@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Nick,

Thank you very much for your answer. I was doing a non-stratified analysis (with distances and areas adjacency matrices) following the script files I found in the zip file here: http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears-validation#BGB_nonstrat_DEC_DECj

However, it seems that the script files are for a stratified analysis that does not include the above-mentioned matrices. Is that right? If so, could you please help me with what has to be changed?

Hi -- the script on the validation page doesn't do everything, it's just validating ancestral state probabilities.  In particular, the "simulate_source_areas_ana_clado(res, clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames)" code is only needed when you want to count events.  

Without "simulate_source_areas_ana_clado(res, clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames)", a BSM knows that this happened:

AB -> ABC

...but it doesn't know if the source area for the dispersal event was "A" or "B".  But, this information is necessary for counting dispersal events, so simulate_source_areas_ana_clado(res, clado_events_tables, ana_events_tables, areanames).


Re: what has to be changed -- use the BSM example script, but run it on a BioGeoBEARS ML analysis that has your distances & areas adjacency files to produce a "res" (or "resDEC" or whatever) results object. Change stratified=TRUE to stratified=FALSE.  That should mostly do it, however, you will have to be patient and figure out other issues that arise (like if you change the name of the results object, you have to change it everywhere it is used), there is no cookbook for custom analyses.  

Cheers!
Nick

Thank you very much for your help.
Justine
